'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Israeli forces]] kill Jihad Kamal Salem Najjar, a member of the [[Hamas military wing]] who was responsible for abducting the [[Yarden Bibas|Bibas family]] in [[Nir Oz]] during the [[October 7 attacks]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/19/world/middleeast/hamas-israel-bibas-kidnapping.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/defense-news/article-864702 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
**Hamas positively receives an [[Egypt|Egyptian]]–[[Qatar|Qatari]]-mediated 60-day ceasefire proposal, which is rejected by [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|Israeli defense minister]] [[Israel Katz]] with [[Ministry of National Security (Israel)|national security minister]] [[Itamar Ben-Gvir]] warning of a "tragedy" if [[Prime minister of Israel|Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] gives in. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/18/world/middleeast/hamas-israel-gaza-ceasefire.html (''The New York Times'')] 
**At least 25 [[Palestinians]] are killed by [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrikes]] in Gaza, including in [[Deir al-Balah]] and [[Khan Younis]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinians-say-25-killed-in-gaza-strikes-overnight-as-aid-efforts-stepped-up/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure (2022–present)|Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch 270 drones and ten [[missile]]s at [[critical infrastructure]] in [[Poltava Oblast|Poltava]] and [[Chernihiv Oblast|Chernihiv Oblasts]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/58536 (''Kyiv Post'')]
*[[Nigerian bandit conflict]]
**At least 27 people are killed and several others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] by bandits at a [[mosque]] in Unguwan Mantau community, [[Katsina State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/bandits-kill-least-27-northern-nigeria-mosque-attack-officials-say-2025-08-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**Six severed heads are discovered on a road that links the states of [[Puebla]] and [[Tlaxcala]] in [[Mexico]]. The [[La Barredora]] cartel is suspected to be behind the attack. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8ry1m202nro (BBC News)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]], [[Gaza war]]
**The [[United Nations]] reports that a record 383 [[aid worker]]s were killed in the 2024 calendar year, up by 31% from 2023, including 181 who were killed in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and 60 in [[Sudan]]. There have already been 265 aid workers killed so far this year. [https://www.dw.com/en/aid-worker-deaths-surge-in-gaza-un-report-says/a-73694336 (DW)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 Air Canada flight attendants strike]]
**[[Air Canada]] announces it will gradually restart operations tonight after it reached a tentative agreement with the [[Canadian Union of Public Employees]], which represents the airline's over 10,000 [[flight attendants]]. [https://www.npr.org/2025/08/19/nx-s1-5507052/air-canada-flights-resume-flight-attendants-union-strike (NPR)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Afghan deportation from Iran]]
**[[2025 Herat road crash]]
***At least 79 people are killed, including 19 children, and three others are injured when an overcrowded passenger bus carrying [[Afghans in Iran|migrants deported from Iran]] veers off a road and collides with a motorcycle and a truck before catching fire in [[Guzara District]], [[Herat Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c336jj5xkvko (BBC News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2025/08/20/afghanistan-bus-crash-iran/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*Four people are killed and nearly a dozen others are injured in a fire at a warehouse in [[Los Guayos Municipality]], [[Carabobo]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://cedarnews.net/newstasks/massive-fire-in-venezuela-los-guayos/871500/ (Cedar News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*The [[Colombia]]n [[Supreme Court of Justice of Colombia|Supreme Court of Justice]] overturns a [[Judiciary of Colombia|lower court]] order placing former [[President of Colombia|president]] [[Álvaro Uribe]] under [[house arrest]] while he appeals convictions for [[bribery]] and [[abuse of process]], ruling that the measure will not apply until the appeal is resolved. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/court-rejects-house-arrest-colombia-ex-president-uribe-during-appeal-2025-08-19/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Peru]]vian [[Constitutional Court of Peru|Constitutional Court]] orders the suspension of all investigations into [[President of Peru|President]] [[Dina Boluarte]], including probes into [[Peruvian protests (2022–2023)#State violence towards protesters|protest-related deaths]], alleged [[illicit enrichment]], and temporary absence from office, until [[Presidency of Dina Boluarte|her term]] ends in July 2026. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peruvian-court-shields-boluarte-criminal-investigations-until-end-term-2025-08-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**Former [[President of Somalia|Somali presidents]] [[Abdiqasim Salad Hassan]], [[Sharif Sheikh Ahmed]] and [[Mohamed Abdullahi Mohamed]] denounce the administration of [[Hassan Sheikh Mohamud]] for its management of public land in [[Somalia]]'s capital [[Mogadishu]], accusing it of violating [[Constitution of Somalia|constitutional]] safeguards and forcibly [[internal displacement|displacing]] impoverished families. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Aug/202606/former_somali_presidents_condemn_land_seizures_accuse_government_of_violating_constitution.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
*[[Eemeli Peltonen]], a 30-year-old [[Parliament of Finland#Members of the Parliament|Finnish member of parliament]], dies by [[Suicide in Finland|suicide]] inside the [[Parliament House, Helsinki|Parliament House]] in [[Helsinki]]. [https://yle.fi/a/74-20178221 (Yle)]
